title: Happy unicorn
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#F5E6E8'/>

  <!-- Happy blush -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='48' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#FFB6C1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='48' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#FFB6C1' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43 50 Q50 57 57 50' stroke='#E88BA0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='47' r='1.2' fill='#E88BA0'/>
